name: job-search-digest
description: Recurring, multi-country job search and CV-tailoring pipeline. Searches job boards, dedupes and scores postings against your CV, tailors CVs for strong matches, and can set up its own recurring Cowork schedule inside a Core project. Requires Google Drive connected (and Gmail if you want digests emailed). Ships with one de-identified, fully generic CV template shared across all three countries, safe to redistribute.
